evidence.appropriate: the name's own O opened at the top with a disc kept at its bottom: what drops in is kept; needs a glance, not a caption
evidence.distinctive: a letter O is common, but none of the five uses one, and the opened top with the kept disc is this mark's own detail
evidence.simple: one O, one slot, one disc; 32 anchors
evidence.legible: 16 px favicon keeps the slot open and the disc separate, thinnest 3.22 px; wordmark x-height 10.2 px at 120 px
evidence.adaptable: black, white and one-colour panels hold; motion: the disc drops through the mouth
evidence.timeless: a round initial invites the AI-era circle cliché; kept away from it by the open top and the single disc (no concentric rings)
evidence.universal: mirrored identical; rotated 90 a C with a dot; upright a faint inverted-keyhole reading
evidence.clear: description search ('letter O logo open at top with dot inside') found only crowded letter-O stock pages (Adobe Stock 1928 results); nothing identical
evidence.congruent: round, symmetric, medium-heavy, open, static; the O matches the name's opening vowel
evidence.system: all lockups and tiers build; wordmark set in the same family as the symbol's O; rationale draft in critique.md
